g.text: Route event by PR & head commit SHA
Initialize SQLite state & set alarm heartbeat
Post initial sticky comment with review link
Download tarball & execute zizmor, ty, oxlint
Start agent turns with rubric, diff, & diagnostics
Confirm findings or dismiss scanner diagnostics
Enforce Docs Gate (refuse finish if no docs checked)
Update sticky PR comment with summary & chips
Step 3: AI Code Review & Docs Gate
